title: Letter Panel Tracing
brief: A museum exhibit has a wall of lettered tiles. Visitors spell a word by touching tiles one after another, where each tile touched must sit directly next to the previous one, and the exhibit needs to know whether a given word can be spelled at all.

Implement canTraceWord(board, word), where board is the grid of tile letters as rows of single characters and word is the word to spell, and return true if the word can be traced on the wall and false otherwise.
